remarks: Discover the charm of Kingswood, a luxurious residential 55+ adult condo community, where 20% or less of residents can be between 21-55 years of age. The light-filled living room doubles as a welcoming dining area, and sports new flooring. The unit includes a reserved parking space (#52), a storage area located on the lower level, and a common laundry room on the unit's floor. The heat pump unit was replaced in 2022, ensuring comfort and efficiency. With low common charges that cover all utilities except phone, cable, and internet, this is a fantastic buy. Kingswood boasts impressive amenities such as two elevators, a community room with a fireplace, pool table, and serving bar, a media room, a fitness center, a business room, a patio, and an outdoor grill. New solar energy system. This community's perfect location offers easy access to i95, close to shops, the beach, transportation and Darien. Don't miss out on this great unit in a well maintained building with secure entry and exceptional amenities. Embrace a lifestyle of convenience and comfort at Kingswood!
